mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( member_id, schedule_seq, seat_seq, status, total_price, reserved_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{scheduleSeq}, #{seatSeq}, #{status}, #{totalPrice}, #{reservedAt}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_seq AS reservationSeq, member_id AS memberId, schedule_seq AS scheduleSeq, seat_seq AS seatSeq, status, total_price AS totalPrice, reserved_at AS reservedAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, cancelled_at AS cancelledAt, cancel_reason AS cancelReason FROM reservation WHERE reservation_seq = #{reservationSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_seq = #{reservationSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_seq AS reservationSeq, member_id AS memberId, schedule_seq AS scheduleSeq, seat_seq AS seatSeq, status, total_price AS totalPrice, reserved_at AS reservedAt, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM reservation WHERE status = 'HELD' AND expires_at < NOW()

SELECT r.reservation_seq AS reservationSeq, r.schedule_seq AS scheduleSeq, s.trainno AS trainNo, t.vehiclekndnm AS vehicleKndNm, ds.nodename AS depStation, as2.nodename AS arrStation, s.depplandtime AS depPlandTime, s.arrplandtime AS arrPlandTime, st.car_no AS carNo, st.seat_no AS seatNo, st.seat_grade AS seatGrade, r.total_price AS totalPrice, r.status, p.order_id AS ticketNumber, r.reserved_at AS reservedAt, r.expires_at AS expiresAt, r.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt FROM reservation r JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_seq = s.schedule_seq LEFT JOIN train t ON s.trainno = t.trainno LEFT JOIN station ds ON s.depplacename = ds.nodeid LEFT JOIN station as2 ON s.arrplacename = as2.nodeid LEFT JOIN seat st ON r.seat_seq = st.seat_seq LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.reservation_seq = p.reservation_seq AND p.status = 'APPROVED' WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.reserved_at DESC
